Areas we serve

Demolition and excavation, Wollongong to Newcastle

Twelve regions and seventy four suburbs, and every one of those suburbs has a page of its own. Western Sydney and the Northern Beaches are where we are most weeks, so there is no travel loading on work in either. Everywhere else is quoted with the travel accounted for honestly rather than hidden in the rates.

0456 220 552

Getting there

What travel actually changes

Plant has to be floated to the job and the spoil has to be carted off it, and both of those are priced by distance. On a Western Sydney or Northern Beaches block neither is a factor, because the machines and the trucks are already in the area most weeks.

Further out, the float and the cartage are costed and shown rather than buried in the rates. If the distance makes a job uneconomic we will tell you that when you ask, not after you have paid for a site visit. Send the address and we will tell you where it sits.

Twelve regions

They are not the same job

What changes between them is the ground, the housing stock, the access and how far the material has to travel once it leaves.
